name: vbox
summary: Vertical layout container that stacks children top-to-bottom with uniform separation. Use for sidebars, stacked form fields, vertical menus, status panels in chain_render_wall HUD overlays. Children auto-size via Container size flags (fill, expand). Pair with HBoxContainer for grid-like layouts. The alignment property (BEGIN/CENTER/END) controls how children pack when total size is less than the container.
example_tscn_snippet:
[node name="MyVBox" type="VBoxContainer" parent="."]
offset_right = 240.0
offset_bottom = 320.0
alignment = 0
theme_override_constants/separation = 8
